Animation.tsx
import {Lottie} from '@remotion/lottie';
import animationData from './animation.json';

export const MyAnimation: React.FC = () => {
  return <Lottie animationData={animationData} />;
};
  • Example using staticFile()
  • Example using a remote URL

Props​

animationData​

A JSON object that adheres to the Lottie schema.

note

If the identity of the object changes, the animation will be re-initialized. Consider memoizing the animationData value.

className​

A CSS class name to be given to the <div> that contains the animation.

direction​

"forward" or "backward"

The direction of the animation. Default: forward.

loop​

boolean

Whether the animation should loop or not. Default: false.

playbackRate​

number

The speed of the animation. A higher number is faster. Default: 1.

style​

CSS properties to be applied to the <div> that contains the animation.

rendererv4.0.105​

"svg" | "canvas" | "html"

Set the renderer for the Lottie files. Default svg. See: renderer option, Supported Features

preserveAspectRatio?v4.0.105​

Set how aspect ratios should be handled in the Lottie file. See preserveAspectRatio

onAnimationLoaded?v3.2.29​

Callback that gets invoked when the Lottie animation has been initialized. The Lottie AnimationItem gets passed as a parameter.


import {Lottie} from '@remotion/lottie';
import {AnimationItem} from 'lottie-web';
import {useCallback} from 'react';

const Comp: React.FC = () => {
  const onAnimationLoaded = useCallback((item: AnimationItem) => {
    console.log(item.renderer);
  }, []);

  return <Lottie animationData={animationData} onAnimationLoaded={onAnimationLoaded} />;
};

assetsPath?v4.0.138​

Set the Lottie assetsPath option. Example: staticFile('lottie') will take assets from the public/lottie folder.

In a Lottie JSON in the assets array, you can reference assets either externally or internally. If e: 0, the assets will be prefixed with assetsPath (ideal if you put the image into your public folder). If e: 1, the assets will be loaded from the absolute URL specified in the JSON.
